note: Inyo NF campground in Jeffrey pine forest on Old Sawmill Road at the edge of Mammoth Lakes, across Hwy 203 from the Welcome Center; a paved path runs to town. Showers are in town. --Claude
summary: rec.gov API + catalog + FS page read. 90 reservable non-electric sites to 38 ft (59 take 23 ft+), flush toilets, water, $10 dump, no showers; $32 + $10 extra vehicle; max stay 14; season late May - early Sep (2027: 05-28 to 09-11). FS page 'Site Closed' is the seasonal closure; the July-Sep forest-health closure covered the forest north of camp and has ended. Pin 257 m from the site centroid. Keep; waterfront unchanged (not waterfront).
